title: Implement authenticated GraphQL artifact-transfer tickets
description:
Purpose: Add the server-authorized transfer plane for large artifacts.

Owned scope:
- Add createArtifactTransferTickets to the Amplify GraphQL schema.
- Add its resolver, storage permissions, and canonical key policy.
- Accept Cognito and workload IAM identities, never public API keys.
- Validate resource existence, ownership boundary, artifact type, filename, content type, size, and SHA-256.
- Return five-minute signed HTTPS transfers in batches of at most twenty.
- Enforce a 100 MiB write limit and prevent caller-selected buckets or paths.

Acceptance:
- Contract tests cover typed validation, authorization rejection, canonical keys, batching, methods, headers, and expiry.
- The operation is additive and deployable before any consumer migration.
- No client-specific information or public transfer capability is introduced.
